interpretation: Paired uncertainty uses independent fight source groups; timestep calibration bins are descriptive.
Critic predicts the combat return including HP, not a calibrated win probability.
Greedy model rollouts do not measure continued search value or real-game outcomes.
Two-particle beliefs and current content support remain approximations; one frozen development panel cannot establish campaign benefit.

protocol.critic_position_selection: opening and midpoint, in report order, only completed Gumbel trajectories with recorded public anchors
protocol.encounter_allocation: cycle in listed order; 16 starts per encounter
protocol.next_gate: credibility of combat benefit and critic diagnosis before increasing depth or scaling training; Act1 gate still required for default search
protocol.primary_contrast: Gumbel64 minus the same frozen normalized greedy network on paired starts
protocol.real_outcome_diagnostic: raw and clipped critic error against actual remaining return for all completed greedy/root/Gumbel decisions; aggregate within each source fight
protocol.rollout_diagnostic: same sampled-world seeds; greedy first action vs search first action then greedy; unfinished simulations have no return
protocol.secondary_contrast: root-action simulation64 minus normalized greedy; descriptive
protocol.stopping: run the fixed panel once; preserve failures/cutoffs. No outcome-adaptive extension or config tuning.
protocol.uncertainty: existing source-group Hoeffding 95% interval; no timestep-independent confidence claims

scope: Controlled Ironclad A0 declared starter-deck combats; development only, no campaign or native acceptance.
